formal_object.rationale: Positive training graph degrees define a reversible chain and nonzero spectral coordinates.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: A06: phi=D^-1/2u and P phi=lambda phi. Condition: D positive F01: phi(x)=sum_j p(x,j)phi_j/lambda. Condition: lambda nonzero and training graph fixed

derivation.rationale: Conjugation gives phi=D^-1/2u and the new-point eigen-equation gives 1/lambda; time coordinates explain lambda^(t-1).

assumptions.rationale: All degrees are positive; retain only stable positive nonzero eigenvalues and remove the stationary direction. Anchors/statistics/coordinates come only from train; no test graph or label selection. Finite graph coordinates do not imply continuum semantic consistency; dot-product scoring is not automatically diffusion distance. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: Fixed graph extension with declared coordinate dot scoring is explicit. It must not be mislabeled diffusion-distance ranking or a new continuum theorem.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Coordinate extrapolation changes rankings only when finite graph neighborhoods carry stable useful structure; near-zero lambda and domain shift create an identifiable failure boundary. Falsification: Matched exact dot/RBF/Nystrom or the corresponding actual diffusion-distance scorer explains equal benefit; graph perturbations destabilize ranking.

closest_alternative.rationale: Known diffusion maps and matched Nystrom/RBF are direct explanations; score norms/stationary weights are an additional semantic control. This check only reviews the stated mathematical comparison; exhaustive full-text/author-code/native collision and originality decisions remain pending.

review_independence: Single-agent self-review; not a blinded/independent novelty or empirical review.
